thag8.1:1.1: Niṭṭhito ca Sattanipāto. AṬṬHANIPĀTO. Kammaṃ bahukaṃ na kāraye, parivajjeyya janaṃ, na uyyame; so ussuko rasānugiddho atthaṃ riñcati yo sukhādhivāho. || ||
thag8.1:2.1: paṅko 'ti hi naṃ avedayuṃ yāyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu, sukhumaṃ sallaṃ durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho. || ||
thag8.1:3.1: na parass' upanidhāya kammaṃ maccassa pāpakaṃ attanā taṃ na seveyya, kammabandhū hi mātiyā. || ||
thag8.1:4.1: na pare vacanā coro, na pare vacanā muni; attānañ ca yathā veti devāpi naṃ tathā vidu. || ||
thag8.1:5.1: pare ca na vijānanti mayam ettha yamāmase; ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā. || ||
thag8.1:6.1: jīvatevāpi sappañño api vittaparikkhayā, paññāya ca alābhena vittavāpi na jīvati. || ||
thag8.1:7.1: sabbaṃ suṇāti sotena, sabbaṃ passati cakkhunā, na ca diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ dhīro sabbam ujjhitum arahati. || ||
thag8.1:8.1: cakkhum' assa yathā andho, sotavā badhiro yathā, paññāv' assa yathā mūgo, balavā dubbalor' iva, atha atthe samuppanne sayetha matasāyikan ti. || || Mahākaccāyano thero.
